sources.title: Structured interview source containing the house-robber prompt

claims.text: The preserved source only states 算法：打家劫舍; the linear layout, skip-all permission, negative values, null/empty behavior and int-to-long API are explicit candidate contracts.
Under the explicit linear non-adjacent-selection contract, the prefix optimum is max(skip current, take current plus optimum two positions back), allowing O(1) rolling state.

Writer and independent reviewer validations compare the candidate behavior against non-adjacent subset brute force across deterministic, exhaustive and seeded randomized arrays, including negative and int-to-long accumulation boundaries.

validation.command: extract exact candidate Java block, compile in independent harness, compare deterministic plus exhaustive and randomized arrays against independent non-adjacent subset brute force

findings: The preserved source contains only the house-robber title; the answer labels linear layout, skip-all, negative values, null/empty behavior and int-to-long API choices as candidate contracts rather than source facts.
The rolling dynamic-programming state is coherent: skip uses the previous prefix optimum while take combines the current value with the optimum two positions back.
The exact candidate compiles under Java 21 and matches independent non-adjacent subset brute force on deterministic, exhaustive and seeded randomized cases.
The answer distinguishes linear, circular and tree variants instead of silently treating them as the same problem.
The O(n) time and O(1) extra-space claims follow from one pass and two retained prefix states.
No fabricated production experience is claimed.
